selection_policy: Freeze datasets, class definitions, label-blind subset indices and hyperparameters before any new test scoring. One final adapter per task; no test-driven search.
limitations: BANKING77-10 and CLINC-10+OOS are explicitly reduced label universes, not original full benchmarks.
ContractNLI retains only whole documents fitting 2048 tokens for every question and evaluates 10 selected documents x 17 hypotheses when available. It does not evaluate evidence extraction.
The Bitcoin hook preserves earlier exploratory negative results; it is not promoted as a trading strategy.
Single-seed, fixed-budget demos are not evidence of state-of-the-art performance or robustness.
